section_2025_present.rule_sentence: In 2025, the NFL changed the overtime rules to allow both teams to have possession during the overtime period, even if the first team scores a touchdown, with the overtime remaining at 10 minutes.
section_2025_present.count_sentence: Through Week 3 of the [[2026 NFL season|2026 season]], a total of 17 regular season games went to overtime, 1 ({{Percentage|1|17|1|pad=yes}}) of which ended in a tie.

section_lead.definition_sentence: In the [[National Football League]] (NFL), a [[Tie (draw)|tied game]] occurs when a [[National Football League regular season|regular season]] game ends with both teams having an equal score after one 10-minute overtime period.
section_lead.most_recent_sentence: The most recent tie game occurred on September 28, 2025, when the [[2025 Green Bay Packers season|Green Bay Packers]] and [[2025 Dallas Cowboys season|Dallas Cowboys]] played to a 40–40 draw.
